title: render run returns render_failed — start from first_error; usually services.dart
symptom: render run ends with render_failed (렌더 명령 실패 = render command failed) and collects nothing. The same failure repeats
cause: The render command (flutter test, etc.) failed to compile or run. The most common cause: the render skeleton lacks the package:flutter/services.dart import, so MethodChannel · SystemChrome are not found
fix: Read first_error in the response first (or output_tail if absent)
On Undefined name · Couldn't find constructor 'MethodChannel', add import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
If you use screen widgets or fake models, also add their package:<app>/... imports
See the pitfalls table in references/render.md
